info.title: Gerrit Code Review REST API
info.description: The Gerrit Code Review REST API. Paths, parameters, and payload schemas are generated statically from the server's REST bindings; human-authored summaries and descriptions are supplied here and merged in at build time.

get.description: Lists the caches of the server. Caches defined by plugins are included.

200.description: A map of CacheInfo keyed by cache name (the default), or an array of cache names with format=LIST. Modeled as a free-form object because a oneOf(array, map) does not generate into compiling SDK code.

post.description: Executes a cache operation that is specified in the request body in a CacheOperationInput entity.

get.description: Retrieves information about a cache.
Lists the capabilities that are available in the system. There are two kinds of capabilities: core and plugin-owned capabilities.

post.description: Runs consistency checks and returns detected problems.

This endpoint allows Gerrit administrators to abandon changes older than some given time. This allows to run change cleanup manually outside of the configured schedule or if change cleanup has been deactivated.

post.summary: Cleanup of already published draft comments
post.description: This endpoint allows Gerrit administrators to cleanup already published draft comments that were not deleted.

put.description: Confirms that the user owns an email address.

get.description: Lists the experiments that are available in the system.
Retrieves the details of the experiment with the given name.

post.description: This endpoint allows Gerrit admins to index a set of changes with one request by providing a IndexChangesInput entity.

get.description: Lists the indexes used by Gerrit. It provides details about the index versions, which index version is used to search and which versions are written to.
Get an index used by Gerrit. It provides details about the index versions, which index version is used to search and which versions are written to.

post.description: Flushes all pending index updates to persistent storage immediately. In contrast to index.name.commitWithin, which schedules index commits, this API forces the flush at call time.
This creates a snapshot of all write index versions of the specified index.

get.description: Lists versions of an index used by Gerrit.
Get info about one version of an index used by Gerrit.

post.description: This endpoint allows to trigger background reindexing of an index version. It is also supported to specify whether to reuse existing up-to-date (non-stale) index documents and whether to notifyListeners or not. The options are provided in the request body as a ReindexIndexVersion.Input entity.

post.summary: Create Snapshot of one Index Version
post.description: This creates a snapshot of one index version of the specified index. The snapshot id may be provided in the request body as a SnapshotIndexVersion.Input entity.

get.description: Returns the public configuration of the Gerrit server as a ServerInfo entity.
Lists the globally defined labels (labels that are added programmatically via the LabelType extension point).
Lists the metrics of the server, returning a map of metric name to a MetricJson entity.
Retrieves a single metric of the server. The metric name is used as the \{metric-id\} and must be URL-encoded because it may contain slashes.

post.summary: Migration of HTTP passwords to authentication tokens
post.description: This endpoint allows Gerrit administrators to migrate remaining HTTP passwords to authentication tokens. For the user the migration is invisible, i.e. the same credential is still valid.

get.description: Returns the default user preferences for the server.

put.description: Sets the default user preferences for the server.

get.description: Returns the default diff preferences for the server.

put.description: Sets the default diff preferences for the server.

get.description: Returns the default edit preferences for the server.

put.description: Sets the default edit preferences for the server.

post.summary: Apply maximum lifetime to authentication tokens
post.description: This endpoint allows Gerrit administrators to apply a shorter maximum lifetime to existing authentication tokens. This is required, when a shorter maximum lifetime is enforced. Changing the configuration will not apply that maximum to existing tokens.
This creates a snapshot of all write index versions. The snapshot id may be provided in the request body as a SnapshotIndexes.Input entity.

get.description: Lists the globally defined submit requirements (submit requirements that are added programmatically via the SubmitRequirement extension point).
Retrieves a summary of the current server state.
Lists the tasks from the background work queues that the Gerrit daemon is currently performing, or will perform in the near future.
Retrieves a task from the background work queue that the Gerrit daemon is currently performing, or will perform in the near future.

delete.description: Kills a task from the background work queue that the Gerrit daemon is currently performing, or will perform in the near future.

get.description: Returns the list of additional top menu entries.
Returns the version of the Gerrit server.

200.description: The Gerrit server version string (the default), or a version object with the verbose option. Modeled as a free-form object to avoid an ungenerable oneOf(string, object).

_account_id.description: The numeric ID of the account.

name.description: The full name of the user. + Only set if detailed account information is requested. + See option DETAILED_ACCOUNTS for change queries + and option DETAILS for account queries.

display_name.description: The display name of the user. + Only set if detailed account information is requested. + See option DETAILED_ACCOUNTS for change queries + and option DETAILS for account queries.

email.description: The email address the user prefers to be contacted through. + Only set if detailed account information is requested. + See option DETAILED_ACCOUNTS for change queries + and options DETAILS and ALL_EMAILS for account queries.

secondary_emails.description: A list of the secondary email addresses of the user. + Only set for account queries when the ALL_EMAILS option or the suggest parameter is set. + Secondary emails are only included if the calling user has the Modify Account, and hence is allowed to see secondary emails of other users.

username.description: The username of the user. + Only set if detailed account information is requested. + See option DETAILED_ACCOUNTS for change queries + and option DETAILS for account queries.

avatars.description: List of AvatarInfo + entities that provide information about avatar images of the account.

_more_accounts.description: Whether the query would deliver more results if not limited. + Only set on the last account that is returned.

deleted.description: Whether the account is deleted. + Only set if detailed account information is requested. + See option DETAILED_ACCOUNTS

tags.description: List of additional tags that this account has. The only + current tag an account can have is SERVICE_USER. + Only set if detailed account information is requested. + See option DETAILED_ACCOUNTS

default_display_name.description: The default strategy for choosing the display name in the UI, see also gerrit.config.

name.description: The unique name of the contributor agreement.

description.description: The description of the contributor agreement.

url.description: The URL of the contributor agreement.

auto_verify_group.description: The group to which a user that signs the contributor agreement online is added automatically as a GroupInfo entity. If not set, users cannot sign the contributor agreement online.

auth_type.description: The authentication type that is configured on the server; see auth.type.

contributor_agreements.description: List of contributor agreements as ContributorAgreementInfo entities.

editable_account_fields.description: List of account fields that are editable. Possible values are FULL_NAME, USER_NAME and REGISTER_NEW_EMAIL.

login_url.description: The login URL. Only set if authentication type is HTTP or HTTP_LDAP.

login_text.description: The login text. Only set if authentication type is HTTP or HTTP_LDAP.

register_url.description: The register URL. Only set if authentication type is LDAP, LDAP_BIND or CUSTOM_EXTENSION.

register_text.description: The register text. Only set if authentication type is LDAP, LDAP_BIND or CUSTOM_EXTENSION.

edit_full_name_url.description: The URL to edit the full name. Only set if authentication type is LDAP, LDAP_BIND or CUSTOM_EXTENSION.

http_password_url.description: The URL to obtain an HTTP password. Only set if authentication type is CUSTOM_EXTENSION.

git_basic_auth_policy.description: The policy to authenticate Git over HTTP and REST API requests when authentication type is LDAP, LDAP_BIND or OAUTH. Can be HTTP, LDAP, HTTP_LDAP or OAUTH.

max_token_lifetime.description: The maximum lifetime of authentication tokens.

url.description: The URL to the avatar image.

height.description: The height of the avatar image in pixels.

name.description: The cache name. If the cache is defined by a plugin the cache name includes the plugin name: "<plugin-name>-<cache-name>".

type.description: The type of the cache (MEM: in memory cache, DISK: disk cache).

entries.description: Information about the entries in the cache as a EntriesInfo entity.

average_get.description: The average duration of getting one entry from the cache. The value is returned with a standard time unit abbreviation (ns: nanoseconds, us: microseconds, ms: milliseconds, s: seconds).

hit_ratio.description: Information about the hit ratio as a HitRatioInfo entity.

allow_blame.description: Whether blame on side by side diff is allowed.

disable_private_changes.description: Returns true if private changes are disabled.

update_delay.description: How often in seconds the web interface should poll for updates to the currently open change.

submit_whole_topic.description: A configuration if the whole topic is submitted.

mergeability_computation_behavior.description: Value of the configuration parameter that controls whether the mergeability bit in ChangeInfo will never be set and if the bit is indexed.

allow_markdown_base64_images_in_comments.description: Are markdown base64 images in comments allowed?.

after.description: Abandon all changes that weren't updated in the timespan given here

if_mergeable.description: Whether to also abandon changes that are mergeable

message.description: Message to post to changes abandoned by the cleanup

query.description: Additional query predicates appended to the base cleanup query. Can be used to limit the batch size, exclude changes, or both, e.g. age:4w limit:100 -project:some/repo -hashtag:keep-alive. By default unset.

config_key.description: The config key that contains the value.

old_value.description: The old config value. + Missing if value was not previously configured.

new_value.description: The new config value, picked up after reload.

token.description: The token that was sent by mail to a newly registered email address.

check_accounts_result.description: The result of running the account consistency check as a CheckAccountsResultInfo entity.

check_account_external_ids_result.description: The result of running the account external ID consistency check as a CheckAccountExternalIdsResultInfo entity.

check_groups_result.description: The result of running the group consistency check as a CheckGroupsResultInfo entity.

check_accounts.description: Input for the account consistency check as CheckAccountsInput entity.

check_account_external_ids.description: Input for the account external ID consistency check as CheckAccountExternalIdsInput entity.

check_groups.description: Input for the group consistency check as CheckGroupsInput entity.

status.description: The status of the consistency problem. + Possible values are FATAL, ERROR and WARNING.

context.description: The number of lines of context when viewing a patch.

tab_size.description: Number of spaces that should be used to display one tab.

font_size.description: Default font size in pixels for change to be displayed in the diff view.

line_length.description: Number of characters that should be displayed in one line.

cursor_blink_rate.description: Half-period in milliseconds used for cursor blinking. Setting it to 0 disables cursor blinking.

expand_all_comments.description: Whether all inline comments should be automatically expanded.

intraline_difference.description: Whether intraline differences should be highlighted.

manual_review.description: Whether the 'Reviewed' flag should not be set automatically on a patch when it is viewed.

show_line_endings.description: Whether Windows EOL/Cr-Lf should be displayed as '\r' in a dotted-line box.

show_whitespace_errors.description: Whether whitespace errors should be shown.

syntax_highlighting.description: Whether syntax highlighting should be enabled.

hide_top_menu.description: If true the top menu header and site header are hidden.

auto_hide_diff_table_header.description: If true the diff table header is automatically hidden when scrolling down more than half of a page.

hide_line_numbers.description: If true the line numbers are hidden.

render_entire_file.description: Whether the whole file should be rendered instead of only the changed parts.

hide_empty_pane.description: Whether empty panes should be hidden. The left pane is empty when a file was added; the right pane is empty when a file was deleted.

match_brackets.description: Whether matching brackets should be highlighted.

line_wrapping.description: Whether to enable line wrapping or not.

responsive_mode.description: The responsive-rendering mode of the diff view. Allowed values are NONE, SHRINK_ONLY and FULL_RESPONSIVE.

ignore_whitespace.description: Whether whitespace changes should be ignored and if yes, which whitespace changes should be ignored. + Allowed values are IGNORE_NONE, IGNORE_TRAILING, IGNORE_LEADING_AND_TRAILING, IGNORE_ALL.

retain_header.description: Whether the header that is displayed above the patch (that either shows the commit message, the diff preferences, the patch sets or the files) should be retained on file switch.

skip_deleted.description: Whether deleted files should be skipped on file switch.

skip_unchanged.description: Whether files without changes are skipped when switching between files.

skip_uncommented.description: Whether uncommented files should be skipped on file switch.

schemes.description: The supported download schemes as a map which maps the scheme name to a of DownloadSchemeInfo entity.

archives.description: List of supported archive formats. Possible values are tgz, tar, tbz2 and txz.

url.description: The URL of the download scheme, where '${project}' is used as placeholder for the project name.

description.description: An optional description of how the scheme works and maybe comparing it to other schemes, explaining the pros and cons of each option.

is_auth_required.description: Whether this download scheme requires authentication.

is_auth_supported.description: Whether this download scheme supports authentication.

commands.description: Download commands as a map which maps the command name to the download command. In the download command '${project}' is used as placeholder for the project name, and '${ref}' is used as placeholder for the (change) ref. Empty, if accessed anonymously and the download scheme requires authentication.

clone_commands.description: Clone commands as a map which maps the command name to the clone command. In the clone command '${project}' is used as placeholder for the project name and '${project-base-name}' as name for the project base name (e.g.

tab_size.description: Number of spaces that should be used to display one tab.

line_length.description: Number of characters that should be displayed per line.

indent_unit.description: Number of spaces that should be used for auto-indent.

cursor_blink_rate.description: Half-period in milliseconds used for cursor blinking. Setting it to 0 disables cursor blinking.

hide_top_menu.description: If true the top menu header and site header is hidden.

show_whitespace_errors.description: Whether whitespace errors should be shown.

syntax_highlighting.description: Whether syntax highlighting should be enabled.

hide_line_numbers.description: Whether line numbers should be hidden.

match_brackets.description: Whether matching brackets should be highlighted.

line_wrapping.description: Whether to enable line wrapping or not.

indent_with_tabs.description: Whether to indent with tabs or not.

auto_close_brackets.description: Whether brackets and quotes should be auto-closed during typing.

show_base.description: Whether to show the inline edit base version or not.

mem.description: Number of cache entries that are held in memory.

disk.description: Number of cache entries on the disk. For non-disk caches this value is not set; for disk caches it is only set if there are entries in the cache.

space.description: The space that is consumed by the cache on disk. The value is returned with a unit abbreviation (k: kilobytes, m: megabytes, g: gigabytes). Only set for disk caches.

type.description: The type of the field, set only for enum-valued fields.

changes_per_page.description: The number of changes to show on each page. Allowed values are 10, 25, 50, 100.

download_scheme.description: The type of download URL the user prefers to use. May be any key from the schemes map in DownloadInfo.

theme.description: Which theme to use. Allowed values are AUTO or DARK or LIGHT.

date_format.description: The format to display the date in. Allowed values are STD, US, ISO, EURO, UK.

time_format.description: The format to display the time in. Allowed values are HHMM_12, HHMM_24.

expand_inline_diffs.description: Whether to expand diffs inline instead of opening as separate page (Gerrit web app UI only).

relative_date_in_change_table.description: Whether to show relative dates in the changes table.

diff_view.description: The type of diff view to show. Allowed values are SIDE_BY_SIDE, UNIFIED_DIFF.

size_bar_in_change_table.description: Whether to show the change sizes as colored bars in the change table.

legacycid_in_change_table.description: Whether to show change number in the change table.

mute_common_path_prefixes.description: Whether to mute common path prefixes in file names in the file table.

signed_off_by.description: Whether to insert Signed-off-by footer in changes created with the inline edit feature.

email_strategy.description: The type of email strategy to use. On ENABLED, the user will receive emails from Gerrit. On CC_ON_OWN_COMMENTS the user will also receive emails for their own comments. On ATTENTION_SET_ONLY, on emails about changes, the user will receive emails only if they are in the attention set of that change.

email_format.description: The format to use for outgoing email. Allowed values are PLAINTEXT and HTML_PLAINTEXT.

default_base_for_merges.description: The base which should be pre-selected in the 'Diff Against' drop-down list when the change screen is opened for a merge commit. Allowed values are AUTO_MERGE and FIRST_PARENT.

publish_comments_on_push.description: Whether to publish draft comments on push by default.

disable_keyboard_shortcuts.description: Whether to disable all keyboard shortcuts.

disable_token_highlighting.description: Whether to disable token highlighting on hover.

work_in_progress_by_default.description: Whether to set work-in-progress on push or on create changes online by default.

my.description: The menu items of the MY top menu as a list of TopMenuItemInfo entities.

change_table.description: The columns to display in the change table (Gerrit web app UI only). The default is empty, which will default columns as determined by the frontend.

allow_browser_notifications.description: Whether to prompt user to enable browser notification in browser.

allow_suggest_code_while_commenting.description: Whether to receive suggested code while writing comments. This feature needs a plugin implementation.

allow_autocompleting_comments.description: Whether to receive autocompletions while writing comments. This feature needs a plugin implementation.

ai_chat_selected_model.description: The name of the AI model selected for the AI chat. This feature needs a plugin implementation.

label_filter.description: A comma-separated list of label names that limits which label columns are shown in the change table. If empty, all labels are shown.

diff_page_sidebar.description: String indicating which sidebar should be open on the diff page. Set to "NONE" if no sidebars should be open. Plugin-supplied sidebars will be prefixed with "plugin-".

all_projects.description: The name of the All-Projects root project.

all_users.description: The name of the All-Users project, in which per-user data such as account preferences and watched projects is stored.

doc_url.description: Custom base URL where Gerrit server documentation is located. (Documentation may still be available at /Documentation relative to the Gerrit base path even if this value is unset.)

edit_gpg_keys.description: Whether to enable the web UI for editing GPG keys.

primary_weblink_name.description: The name of the configured primary web link (gerrit.primaryWeblinkName), if one is set.

instance_id.description: Short identifier for this Gerrit installation.

default_branch.description: Name of the default branch to use on the project creation.

project_state_predicate_enabled.description: Whether the instance supports filtering projects by state.

url.description: URL to information about the group. Typically a URL to a web page that permits users to apply to join the group, or manage their membership.

group_id.description: The numeric ID of the group.

owner.description: The name of the owner group.

owner_id.description: The URL encoded UUID of the owner group.

created_on.description: The timestamp of when the group was created.

_more_groups.description: Whether the query would deliver more results if not limited. + Only set on the last group that is returned by a group query.

members.description: A list of AccountInfo entities describing the direct members. + Only set if members are requested.

includes.description: A list of GroupInfo entities describing the direct subgroups. + Only set if subgroups are requested.

id.description: The URL encoded UUID of the group.

name.description: The name of the group. + For external groups the group name is missing if there is no group backend that can resolve the group UUID. E.g. this can happen when a plugin that provided a group backend was uninstalled.

visible_to_all.description: Whether the group is visible to all registered users.

mem.description: Hit ratio for cache entries that are held in memory (0 \<= value \<= 100).

disk.description: Hit ratio for cache entries that are held on disk (0 \<= value \<= 100). Only set for disk caches.

changes.description: List of change-ids. When delete_missing is true, each entry must be in project~changeNumber format.

delete_missing.description: Delete changes which are missing in NoteDb from the index. This can be used to get rid of stale index entries. Possible values are true and false. By default set to false.

vm_vendor.description: The vendor of the virtual machine.

vm_name.description: The name of the virtual machine.

vm_version.description: The version of the virtual machine.

os_name.description: The name of the operating system.

os_version.description: The version of the operating system.

os_arch.description: The architecture of the operating system.

user.description: The user that is running Gerrit.

host.description: The host on which Gerrit is running.

site.description: The path to the review site.

project_name.description: The name of the project in which this label is defined. Not set for globally defined labels.

function.description: The function of the label (can be MaxWithBlock, AnyWithBlock, MaxNoBlock, NoBlock, NoOp and PatchSetLock.

values.description: The values of the label as a map of label value to value description. The label values are formatted strings, e.g. "+1" instead of "1", " 0" instead of "0".

default_value.description: The default value of the label (as integer).

branches.description: A list of branches for which the label applies. A branch can be a ref, a ref pattern or a regular expression. If not set, the label applies for all branches.

can_override.description: Whether this label can be overridden by child projects.

allow_post_submit.description: Whether allowPostSubmit is set on the label.

ignore_self_approval.description: Whether ignoreSelfApproval is set on the label.

total.description: The total size of the memory. The value is returned with a unit abbreviation (k: kilobytes, m: megabytes, g: gigabytes).

used.description: The size of used memory. The value is returned with a unit abbreviation (k: kilobytes, m: megabytes, g: gigabytes).

free.description: The size of free memory. The value is returned with a unit abbreviation (k: kilobytes, m: megabytes, g: gigabytes).

buffers.description: The size of memory used for JGit buffers. The value is returned with a unit abbreviation (k: kilobytes, m: megabytes, g: gigabytes).

max.description: The maximal memory size. The value is returned with a unit abbreviation (k: kilobytes, m: megabytes, g: gigabytes).

name.description: Name of the top menu entry.

url.description: The URL of the menu item link.

name.description: The name of the menu item.

target.description: Target attribute of the menu item link.

id.description: The id attribute of the menu item link.

name.description: The metadata name. Not guaranteed to be unique, e.g. multiple metadata entries with the same name may be returned.

web_links.description: A list of web links as WebLinkInfo entities.

unit.description: The unit of measurement of the recorded values.

constant.description: Whether the metric reports a single constant value.

rate.description: Whether the metric reports a rate.

gauge.description: Whether the metric is a gauge that reports an instantaneous value.

cumulative.description: Whether the metric accumulates over time.

value.description: The current value, for constant metrics and gauges.

rate_mean.description: The mean rate since the metric was registered.

p50.description: The median (50th percentile) of the recorded values.

p75.description: The 75th percentile of the recorded values.

p95.description: The 95th percentile of the recorded values.

p98.description: The 98th percentile of the recorded values.

p99.description: The 99th percentile of the recorded values.

p99_9.description: The 99.9th percentile of the recorded values.

avg.description: The average of the recorded values.

sum.description: The sum of the recorded values.

std_dev.description: The standard deviation of the recorded values.

fields.description: The fields of the metric as a list of FieldJson entities.

buckets.description: The per-field-value breakdown of the metric, as a map of field values to the recorded value for that combination.

has_avatars.description: Whether an avatar provider is registered.

js_resource_paths.description: A list of relative paths (strings). Each path points to a frontend plugin that should be loaded, e.g. plugins/codemirror_editor/static/codemirror_editor.js.

operation.description: The cache operation that should be executed: FLUSH_ALL: Flushes all caches, except the web_sessions cache. FLUSH: Flushes the specified caches.

caches.description: A list of cache names. This list defines the caches on which the specified operation should be executed. Whether this list must be specified depends on the operation being executed.

enable_signed_push.description: Whether signed push validation support is enabled on the server; see the global configuration for details.

lifetime.description: The new maximum lifetime that will be applied to authentication tokens.

reuse.description: Whether existing documents may be reused instead of being recomputed while reindexing.

notify_listeners.description: Whether index listeners should be notified about the reindex progress.

accounts.description: Information about the configuration from the accounts section as AccountsConfigInfo entity.

auth.description: Information about the authentication configuration as AuthInfo entity.

change.description: Information about the configuration from the change section as ChangeConfigInfo entity.

download.description: Information about the configured download options as DownloadInfo entity. information about Gerrit

gerrit.description: Information about the configuration from the gerrit section as GerritInfo entity.

groups.description: Information about the configuration from the groups section as GroupsConfigInfo entity.

note_db_enabled.description: Whether the NoteDb storage backend is fully enabled.

plugin.description: Information about Gerrit extensions by plugins as PluginConfigInfo entity.

sshd.description: Information about the configuration from the sshd section as SshdInfo entity. Not set if SSHD is disabled.

suggest.description: Information about the configuration from the suggest section as SuggestInfo entity.

user.description: Information about the configuration from the user section as UserConfigInfo entity.

receive.description: Information about the receive-pack configuration as a ReceiveInfo entity.

default_theme.description: URL to a default Gerrit UI theme plugin, if available. Located in /static/gerrit-theme.js by default.

submit_requirement_dashboard_columns.description: The list of submit requirement names that should be displayed as separate columns in the dashboard. If empty, the default is to display all submit requirements that are applicable for changes appearing in the dashboard.

dashboard_show_all_labels.description: Whether to show all labels in the dashboard, even if they are not submit requirements.

metadata.description: Optional server metadata as a list of MetadataInfo entities. If and which metadata is provided depends on the Gerrit setup.

id.description: A string ID that will be used as the folder name containing the snapshots. Defaults to current timestamp.
A string ID that will be used as the folder name containing the snapshot. Defaults to current timestamp.
A string ID that will be used as the folder name containing the snapshots. Defaults to current timestamp.

project_name.description: The name of the project in which this submit requirement is defined. Not set for globally defined submit requirements.

applicability_expression.description: Query expression that can be evaluated on any change. If evaluated to true on a change, the submit requirement is then applicable for this change. If not specified, the submit requirement is applicable for all changes.

submittability_expression.description: Query expression that can be evaluated on any change. If evaluated to true on a change, the submit requirement is fulfilled and not blocking change submission.

override_expression.description: Query expression that can be evaluated on any change. If evaluated to true on a change, the submit requirement is overridden and not blocking change submission.

allow_override_in_child_projects.description: Whether this submit requirement can be overridden in child projects.

from.description: The number of characters that a user must have typed before suggestions are provided.

task_summary.description: Summary about current tasks as a TaskSummaryInfo entity.

mem_summary.description: Summary about current memory usage as a MemSummaryInfo entity.

thread_summary.description: Summary about current threads as a ThreadSummaryInfo entity.

jvm_summary.description: Summary about the JVM JvmSummaryInfo entity. Only set if the jvm option was set.

state.description: The state of the task, can be DONE, CANCELLED, RUNNING, READY, SLEEPING and OTHER.

start_time.description: The start time of the task.

delay.description: The remaining delay of the task.

remote_name.description: The remote name. May only be set for tasks that are associated with a project.

project_name.description: The project the task is associated with.

queue_name.description: The work queue the task is associated with.

threads.description: The total number of current threads.

counts.description: Detailed thread counts as a map that maps a thread kind to a map that maps a thread state to the thread count.

anonymous_coward_name.description: Username that is displayed in the Gerrit Web UI and in e-mail notifications if the full name of the user is not set.

tooltip.description: Tooltip to show when hovering over the link. Using "Open in $NAME_OF_EXTERNAL_TOOL" is a good option here.

image_url.description: URL to the icon of the link.

basicAuth.description: HTTP basic auth with a username and a generated HTTP password.

tags.name: accounts
tags.description: Accounts, preferences, SSH keys, and capabilities.

tags.name: changes
tags.description: Changes, revisions, comments, reviewers, and edits.
